title: Ideal Tape Bits
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tapes, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, let $t\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\tau$ be a tape index of $M$. If there is no previous visit of tape $\tau$ by time $t$, assign the list of $\mathrm{snapWidth}(M)+1$ false bits. Otherwise, assign a true bit followed by the encoding of the machine snapshot at the previous visit.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine with Boolean tapes
